claims.text: The hotel is in the heart of Sathorn.

findings.quote: Experience luxury liberated in the vibrant heart of Sathorn at W Bangkok.

claims.text: The hotel is near the BTS SkyTrain's Chong Nonsi Station.

findings.quote: All of Bangkok is within reach from our hotel near the BTS SkyTrain & Bangkok's Chong Nonsi Station

claims.text: Paii serves modern Thai seafood at The House on Sathorn.

findings.quote: Paii, serving modern Thai seafood in one of Bangkok's most iconic landmarks.
Here, the contemporary Thai seafood at Paii, the innovative cocktails of Bar Sathorn, and the serene alfresco Courtyard

claims.text: Bar Sathorn serves cocktails inspired by the historic mansion, blending Thai culture and local ingredients.

findings.quote: Bar Sathorn at The House on Sathorn serves signature cocktails and mocktails inspired by the historic mansion, blending Thai culture, local ingredients, and creative mixology.

claims.text: The outdoor WET pool on the sixth floor is surrounded by lounge chairs, couches and covered day beds.

findings.quote: Situated on the sixth floor, our inviting 206-square-meter outdoor pool is an urban oasis surrounded by lounge chairs, couches, and covered day beds.
Day and Night Lounging at W Bangkok's WET®

claims.text: Rooms and suites have touchscreen lighting controls to set the mood.

findings.quote: Use a touchscreen to illuminate your room or suite and match one of Bangkok's many playful moods.

claims.text: The hotel grows organic vegetables on its rooftop using compost from its kitchens.

findings.quote: By composting food waste from the hotel's kitchens and transforming it into nutrient-rich soil, the hotel is able to grow fresh, organic vegetables directly on the rooftop.

claims.text: The House on Sathorn Heritage Tour explores the building's history.

findings.quote: Explore the architectural masterpiece and discover the stories that have shaped this historical building over the years.
The House on Sathorn Heritage Tour

claims.text: The Presidential Suite is a top-floor corner suite with a whirlpool.

findings.quote: 1 Bedroom Presidential Suite, 1 King, Corner room, Top floor, Whirlpool

claims.text: The House on Sathorn is a preserved neo-classical landmark from 1889 that has been a private residence, a hotel and the Russian Embassy.

findings.quote: Housed in a beautifully preserved neo-classical landmark dating back to 1889, the building has evolved from a private residence to a hotel, the Russian Embassy, and today, a treasured part of W Bangkok.
Since opening in 2015, The House on Sathorn has become one of Bangkok’s most distinctive dining and social destinations.

claims.text: The hotel has two parts: the century-old House on Sathorn and a sleek 31-story glass tower.

findings.quote: the historical, century-old The House on Sathorn and the sleek 31-story glass tower

claims.text: The pool has in-pool LED lights in bold hues and underwater music.

findings.quote: highlight in-pool LED lights that emit a spectrum of bold hues while underwater music adds to the enchanting ambiance

claims.text: AWAY Spa on the sixth floor has four zones.

findings.quote: Experience rejuvenation across four zones in the sixth-floor spa
Indulge in pure relaxation at W Bangkok's AWAY® Spa

claims.text: The Whatever/Whenever service can arrange a banquet cruising the Chao Phraya River or a helicopter ride over temples and skyscrapers.

findings.quote: An indulgent banquent while cruising the Chao Phraya River? A helicopter ride over traditional temple sprites and skyscraper tips? At W Bangkok, our whatever/whenever service transforms the ordinary into an extraordinary.

claims.text: The pool and fitness center are reserved for in-house guests.

findings.quote: W Bangkok offers 24/7 hotel facilities including an outdoor swimming pool, WET, and FIT-fitness. Both are on the 6th floor and reserved for in-house guests only.

claims.text: One pet up to 18 kg is allowed per room.

findings.quote: One pet is allowed per room, with a maximum weight of 18.0 kgs.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the modern lifestyle style may not suit traditional luxury preferences.
